title: Feeding one at another’s expense
literal_meaning: Like killing grasshoppers to feed a myna.
explanation: The image exposes a benefit obtained by making another bear the loss. The explanation follows the contrast between the creature killed and the one nourished.
meaning_odia: ଜଣକର କ୍ଷତି କରି ଅନ୍ୟ ଜଣକର ଲାଭ କରାଇବା। ଝିଣ୍ଟିକା ମରେ, ବଣି ଖାଇ ବଞ୍ଚେ—ଏହି ବିପରୀତ ଫଳ ହିଁ କଥାଟିର ମୂଳ।
usage_example: A manager improves one team’s figures by shifting its unfinished work onto another team. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The dictionary labels the expression ପ୍ରବଚନ. Its linked insect and bird entries support the literal image; the social application is editorial.
